purpose: Teach: オリックス/テレビ朝日/スズキ/男優/ソビエト/ケニア/司馬/ブルジョアジー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオリックスの試合を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to show you an Orix game.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone with gentle affection. A slow, easy rhythm. The kind of thing an older sister says when sharing something she knows will make him happy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとテレビ朝日のアニメ観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched an anime on TV Asahi with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Quick delivery, animated. The cadence of a child who wants to share something good right now, riding over politeness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスズキの新車をお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought a new Suzuki car.
lines.style: Soft, observant delivery. A pause before the main point — she's watching how he takes it. Gentle, almost musical rhythm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと男優のドラマ観たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to watch a drama with Dad — one with actors in it.
lines.style: Eager and insistent, building slightly on 'want.' Not whining, but earnest. The persistence of a six-year-old testing if his wish gets heard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがソビエトの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to read you a picture book about the Soviet Union.
lines.style: Unhurried, slightly curious tone. She's sharing something a little unusual without making it strange. Warm underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとケニアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book about Kenya with Dad.
lines.style: Immediate, bright, proud. The slight elongation of 'saw' — he's enjoying the world. Light, uncomplicated joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが司馬遼太郎の小説を貸して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad lent you a novel by Shiba Ryotaro.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. A slower pace on the author's name — respectful, almost. She notices what he's reading. Warm and attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ブルジョアジーって何?お父さんに聞くね
lines.en: Mei-sis, what does bourgeoisie mean? I'm going to ask Dad.
lines.style: Curious, direct question with a hint of determination. No self-consciousness. The confidence of a child who trusts his father to know. Quick, genuine.
